entities.name: PLMN selection
entities.description: Procedure where the UE selects a PLMN. If a new PLMN is selected, the UE resets the attach attempt counter and initiates attach procedures.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Standard attach procedure initiated after PLMN selection when a new PLMN is selected.

entities.name: Attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Emergency attach procedure initiated when the selected cell is known not to provide normal service.

entities.name: Attach for access to RLOS
entities.description: Attach procedure for access to RLOS initiated when the selected cell is known not to provide normal service.

entities.name: Attach attempt counter
entities.description: Counter tracking attach attempts, which is reset when a new PLMN is selected.

entities.name: New PLMN selected
entities.description: Condition where the UE selects a new PLMN during PLMN selection.

entities.name: Selected cell known not to provide normal service
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell is known not to be able to provide normal service.

relations.description: PLMN selection may result in a new PLMN being selected.
When a new PLMN is selected, the UE resets the attach attempt counter.
When a new PLMN is selected, the UE initiates the attach procedure.
If the selected cell is known not to provide normal service, the UE may initiate attach for emergency bearer services.
If the selected cell is known not to provide normal service, the UE may initiate attach for access to RLOS.
